title: Waters' Tetra Chaos
description: Tetra + Optional Compatible Mods. Designed to make the game more challenging and expansive. Bigger bosses, more events, harder mobs, better combat, more rewarding progress.
body:
Waters’ Tetra Extra is a Forge 1.20.1 modpack built around Tetra’s modular tools and weapons, expanded into a full RPG adventure with progression, exploration, and high‑impact combat.

You’ll start with simple, hand‑crafted gear and gradually forge legendary weapons by combining modules, improvements, enchantments, and leveling systems. Along the way, you’ll battle bosses from L_Ender’s Cataclysm, delve into the Twilight Forest, and survive a world filled with dangerous mobs and powerful loot.

This pack is tuned for small groups or solo players who want deep gear customization with a clear sense of progression, without turning Minecraft into a tech grind.
